# The State Of Cloud In Manufacturing, 2024

## Firms Overcome Early Hesitancy Around Latency And Sovereignty In The Race To Transform An Old Industry

Paul Miller,

Dario Maisto,

and 

 Jan 18, 2024 

### Summary

The manufacturing sector was slower than others to adopt cloud computing, with limited connectivity to factories and machines, internal challenges aligning IT and operational technology (OT) initiatives, and concerns around digital sovereignty and cybersecurity all inhibiting early growth. This data-driven report examines the current state of public cloud adoption in manufacturing and shows how far the sector has come in integrating public cloud infrastructure into their technology landscape.
